sc: The amulet of magic is an amulet created by casting the Lvl-1 Enchant spell on a sapphire amulet.

It is used most commonly by mages as it provides an excellent magical bonus - the second highest in free-to-play, after the Dungeoneering reward arcane blast necklace bought with Dungeoneering tokens, but the amulet of magic has no requirements and is cheaply available.
Ancient Necronium Scythe is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 49 of the Expedition to the Wilderness Yak Track with the premier pass.
Argonite boots is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
It is made by dyeing a pair of augmented elite sirenic chaps with a shadow dye.
It may also be made by augmenting a pair of elite sirenic chaps (shadow) at an inventor's workbench.

sc: Blue Christmas Present is a possible reward from the 2022 Christmas event for handing in 200 pieces of Christmas wrapping paper at Postie Pete, or as a free daily present.

Despite the removal of Romeo & Juliet, the potion can still be created by taking cadava berries to the apothecary, but it no longer has any practical use.

Caelyn's spare hat is a head override originally unlocked through the 2020 Easter event, in which it could be obtained by giving Caelyn's calling card to the Easter Bunny and taking the faded easter letter he gives you to Caelyn Kadaan.
It can be purchased in the seasonally available The Grand Eggs-change in the Blooming Burrow for 800 spring tokens.
